dates.chronologyKeyBasis: Spans the 31 March 1695 removal order through the 1696 enforcement determination.

outgoing.explanation: The 1695-96 warning-out record is direct primary evidence of the Providence John Gurney household.

shortLabel: 1695-96 Providence warning-out of John Gurney, a stranger

sources.locator: Providence Town Records 1677-1750, images 166-168 (arks 3Q9M-C9B8-WS3V-Y, WS3C-L, WS3F-S)

statement: Providence, Rhode Island's town council ordered a transient "John Gurney" to leave town on 31 March 1695; when he returned, the council in 1696 ordered him apprehended and fined 5 shillings or whipped twelve stripes and removed from town.
